Catalog price USD 0.01 in USDC on Base via x402 (catalog id 5fd185ffb0d48c8a307e4fb1). Caps 0.01 per call, 0.05 total, session TTL 1 hour. sources: kpass 6.13.2 --help, session create --help, session execute --help, session status --help
kpassContract.sessionCreate: session create --delegation <inner JSON> --separate --no-reuse --no-browser --no-interactive --output json; delegation task.summary (<=80 chars), payment_policy {max_amount_per_tx, max_total_amount, ttl_seconds, currency}, execution_constraints.x402 scoped (recorded, not enforced by Kite), routing_enabled false; answer status human_action_required with request_id, approval_url, expires_at (exit 0).
kpassContract.sessionStatus: session status --request-id <req> --no-interactive --output json; pending (exit 0) -> ACCEPTED; success + session.status active -> CONFIRMED (session.id, expires_at, delegation.payment_policy, usage.spent_total); exit 3 rejected/expired -> FAILED (no session); another request_id -> never taken; else UNKNOWN.
kpassContract.sessionExecute: session execute --session-id <bound> --url <exact URL, query included> --method GET --idempotency-key <pre-egress key> --no-browser --no-interactive --output json; no --body/--headers/--use-allowance. Success: exit 0, status success, session_id = bound, no source allowance, x402.status_code 2xx, payment_requirement.asset USDC, x402.chain_id 8453 if present, payment_requirement.amount decimal USD converted exactly to minor units, reference payment.payment_response.reference. Documented pre-spend codes with their documented exits are not-sent refusals; exit 7, payment_settled_unfulfilled, policy refusals and undocumented exits are UNKNOWN.
adapterChanges: GET parameters travel in the bound URL; the JSON body carrying purpose and the client operation id is no longer sent
payment_requirement.amount is decimal USD ('0.01'), converted exactly (was read as minor units)
the paying session must be the authority's own (session_id match, no allowance source); asset, chain and 2xx checked
the bound session is re-read before paying: active, unexpired, caps inside the hard caps; request id bound (S1)
documented pre-spend refusals only are not-sent; the undocumented exit 8 is now UNKNOWN
session create adds --no-reuse, --no-browser, --no-interactive, a reviewable summary, scoped constraints and routing_enabled false
session status maps pending to ACCEPTED and rejected/expired to FAILED
hard caps in code: 1 cent per call, 5 cents per session (KITE_HARD_CAPS)
kpass runs with cwd and HOME at the state root, a fixed environment (KPASS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK, KPASS_AUTO_UPGRADE=0, KPASS_NO_BROWSER) and only when <stateRoot>/.kite-passport is private (S4)
the approval link reaches only an operator callback, only for https on agentpassport.ai (S2); readiness and session-usage reads added
paid execution needs manualReconciliationAccepted (attended) or verified replay; capability stays non-autonomous
the adapter file (uptimebuyer-kite-broker-adapter.v1, 0600, outside the repo) is parsed strictly; merchant ids must be mer_ ids

sameKeyReplay.basis: The docs tell agents to reuse the same key and identical request for a transport retry and say a pending outcome retried with the same key charges nothing new, but only for the account allowance and recurring payments (x402-execute SKILL.md 'Recurring and shared allowance payments'; --idempotency-key help 'reuse with identical input when retrying a recurring payment'). Nothing promises the original result for a same-key replay of a separate-session payment.
sameKeyReplay.consequence: sameKeyReplayVerified stays false; the duplicate request is the product's own protection: the identical intent request (same idempotency key) returns the existing intent and the broker sends nothing (duplicate.json records sameIntentReturned true and secondEgress false).
